basic_info.description:
2+ BR, 2 BA FURNISHED Condo, in great neighborhood. Available up to 6 months. 1/2 block from Golden Gate Park. Very walkable. Updated kitchen and bathrooms. Primary suite includes heated floors in bathroom, extra room that can be great office space, nursery, or bonus room. In unit washer/dryer, Wolf range, dishwasher. Large closets in both bedrooms. Kitchen opens to dining room. Great light in all rooms. Access to garden. 1 tandem parking space available for additional fee. Fresh paint throughout. Landlords live in upstairs unit. Month to month, minimum of one month. Utilities included.

Owner pays for water and utilities (Gas and electric) no cable service included. Security deposit due at signing. No smoking or vaping.

exteriorFeatures: Parking with EV charging access is an additional $200/month
